claims.claim: FMC Q2 2026 revenue fell 17% year over year to $867M and adjusted EBITDA fell 26% to $153M; management lowered full-year revenue and EBITDA outlooks amid price/volume pressure while reporting $363M operating cash flow helped by a $200M rimisoxafen licensing prepayment.

FMC has assembled roughly $1B of intended debt-paydown proceeds through the Corteva prepayment, India sale, Newark sale-leaseback, Tessenderlo minority investment and other actions, but several transactions remain subject to closing conditions.

risks.risk: Core legacy-product price and volume pressure plus higher interest expense remain material while deleveraging depends partly on transactions not yet fully closed.

contradictions.contradiction: Cash generation and planned deleveraging improved while underlying revenue and EBITDA deteriorated materially.

unknowns.unknown: Net leverage after all announced transactions close and the sustainable earnings contribution from new active ingredients remain unproven.

claims.claim: Execution is currently a balance-sheet repair plus portfolio-transition story: debt-reduction actions are concrete, but management's lowered 2026 operating outlook shows the core earnings recovery has not yet been demonstrated.

risks.risk: Announced financing and asset actions can improve liquidity without resolving weak end-market pricing or legacy-product demand.

unknowns.unknown: Whether the expected Q4 return to year-over-year growth occurs remains a forward expectation rather than observed evidence.
